formulas.ascii: rightRows[i]=smallest valid right row j with rightKeys[j]==leftKeys[i], else 0xffffffff; null keys never match; duplicate right keys are supported.

snapshots.name: leftKeys
snapshots.meaning: Tract id of each iNaturalist observation.

snapshots.name: tractKeys
snapshots.meaning: Tract id of each tract; the right keys are unique.

snapshots.name: hasEstimate
snapshots.meaning: Right mask: 1 when the tract has a poverty estimate.

snapshots.name: poverty150Pct
snapshots.meaning: Share of residents below 150% of the poverty line.

snapshots.name: rightRows
snapshots.meaning: Smallest matching right row; 0xffffffff when unmatched.

snapshots.name: joinedPoverty
snapshots.meaning: Gathered poverty of the matching tract; NaN when unmatched.

snapshots.name: rightKeys
snapshots.meaning: Key of the right row each observation matched (tractKeys[rightRows[i]]); NaN if none.
